headline: US Activates USMCA Rapid Response Labor Mechanism Against Polygroup Industrias
summary: The EU has activated the USMCA rapid-response labour mechanism against Polygroup Industrias, a maker of plastic goods and holiday decorations. The complaint alleges violations of freedom of association and collective bargaining.
why: The USMCA rapid-response labour mechanism allows complaints about labour rights at facilities in member countries, which can lead to enforcement action and affect trade flows. It is a tool that matters for supply chains in North America.
original_headline: EU activa el Mecanismo Laboral de Respuesta Rápida del T-MEC contra Polygroup Industrias
